page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 960.0 and a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1109.99. However, the 32 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance, with a Passmark CPU score of 22982.48 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 8426.0. Memory bandwidth benchmarks show average throughput, reaching 74.54 GB/sec for large block read-only operations, though the Passmark memory score is positioned in the bottom 25%.

This instance is best suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage its 32 dedicated cores, such as static web serving, multi-threaded decompression, and moderate database operations. It achieves an average static web serving throughput of 13.68 GB/sec and 23.27 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. Due to its lower memory-to-CPU ratio of 1:2 and weak single-threaded performance, it is less optimal for memory-intensive applications or single-core bound tasks.
